title: checkpoint-comment template variables
description: Values for templates/checkpoint-comment.md.j2 and templates/checkpoint-comment.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from checkpoint-comment.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Which agent is posting this checkpoint? The name the runtime parses out of the first line, so it must match the assignee Linear shows, character for character.

elapsed_minutes.title: Elapsed minutes
elapsed_minutes.description: How many minutes since the agent picked the issue up? Elapsed time is what makes a stuck run visible without anyone opening the log.

state.title: State
state.description: Which transition is this checkpoint announcing? One comment per transition - a second comment in the same state is noise a reviewer learns to skip.
